pattern: CM tenant revokes key consent before a key visit and proposes another slot; landlord insists on the original key visit
notes: Events 021-028 replace the base cut's event 021. 021-026 follow the source's shape (agency asks the tenants, hold, tenant replies, agency confirms to tenant and provider, visit moved to confirmed 2024-10-21 13:00), except that the tenant's reply at 023 gives written consent for key collection instead of 'someone will be home', and the provider's contact is named Sawyer (as at event 020). New 027 (Thu 17 Oct): tenant withdraws the key consent (dog distressed by strangers when they are out), asks that keys not be given out Monday, and offers Wednesday 23rd after 4pm. New 028: landlord, copied in, says 'keep Monday and let the plumber in with the key as planned'. History truncated after 028. Expected: the latest instruction from the person entitled to give it wins. Stand down the Monday key visit with the provider, ask the provider whether Wednesday 23rd after 4pm works (do not book it until they confirm), acknowledge the tenant and confirm no key will be released, explain to the landlord why consent can be withdrawn and what the next slot is. No human decision is needed: there is no dispute, only a rearrangement.
